children: HE Sheikh Khalifa bin Ali Al Harthy, Undersecretary for Political Affairs in the Foreign Ministry, held talks with Jonathan Burke, Assistant Secretary of the US Department of the Treasury for Counter Terrorist Financing and Financial Crimes, on Wednesday.
The meeting reviewed bilateral relations between Oman and the United States and ways to strengthen cooperation and coordination on issues of mutual interest.
The two sides also exchanged views on current regional developments and discussed areas of continued coordination.
The meeting was attended by the US Ambassador to Oman and officials from both countries.
